t.id=e.task_id and t.del_flag='0' and t.current_block_flag='1' join lab_member owner on owner.id=t.owner_id and owner.member_status='ACTIVE' and owner.del_flag='0' join sys_user owner_user on owner_user.user_id=owner.user_id and owner_user.status='0' and owner_user.del_flag='0' where e.block_status='OPEN' and e.del_flag='0' union all select distinct e.task_id,t.title,e.episode_no,e.block_start_time,t.coordination_owner_id,'COORDINATOR',null,t.period from lab_task_block_event e join lab_task t on t.id=e.task_id and t.del_flag='0' and t.current_block_flag='1' join lab_member coordinator on coordinator.id=t.coordination_owner_id and coordinator.member_status='ACTIVE' and coordinator.del_flag='0' join sys_user coordinator_user on coordinator_user.user_id=coordinator.user_id and coordinator_user.status='0' and coordinator_user.del_flag='0' join sys_user_role coordinator_link on coordinator_link.user_id=coordinator_user.user_id join sys_role coordinator_role on coordinator_role.role_id=coordinator_link.role_id and coordinator_role.status='0' and coordinator_role.del_flag='0' where e.block_status='OPEN' and e.del_flag='0' and t.coordination_required='1' and t.coordination_owner_id<>t.owner_id and (coordinator_role.role_key='lab_manager' or (coordinator_role.role_key='lab_lead' and coordinator.biz_line=t.biz_line)) union all select e.task_id,t.title,e.episode_no,e.block_start_time,manager_member.id,'MANAGER',null,t.period from lab_task_block_event e join lab_task t on t.id=e.task_id and t.del_flag='0' and t.current_block_flag='1' join sys_role manager_role on manager_role.role_key='lab_manager' and manager_role.status='0' and manager_role.del_flag='0' join sys_user_role manager_link on manager_link.role_id=manager_role.role_id join sys_user manager_user on manager_user.user_id=manager_link.user_id and manager_user.status='0' and manager_user.del_flag='0' join lab_member manager_member on manager_member.user_id=manager_user.user_id and manager_member.member_status='ACTIVE' and manager_member.del_flag='0' where e.block_status='OPEN' and e.del_flag='0' order by task_id,episode_no,recipient_id,audience

mapper.select: select t.id task_id,t.title task_title,null episode_no,null block_start_time,t.owner_id recipient_id,'OWNER' audience, missing_fields,t.period from lab_task t join lab_member owner on owner.id=t.owner_id and owner.member_status='ACTIVE' and owner.del_flag='0' join sys_user owner_user on owner_user.user_id=owner.user_id and owner_user.status='0' and owner_user.del_flag='0' where union all select t.id,t.title,null,null,manager_member.id,'MANAGER',,t.period from lab_task t join sys_role manager_role on manager_role.role_key='lab_manager' and manager_role.status='0' and manager_role.del_flag='0' join sys_user_role manager_link on manager_link.role_id=manager_role.role_id join sys_user manager_user on manager_user.user_id=manager_link.user_id and manager_user.status='0' and manager_user.del_flag='0' join lab_member manager_member on manager_member.user_id=manager_user.user_id and manager_member.member_status='ACTIVE' and manager_member.del_flag='0' where #{managerEscalation}=true and order by task_id,recipient_id,audience
mapper.update: update lab_reminder set read_flag='1',read_time=#{readTime},update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and recipient_id=#{recipientId} and version=#{version} and read_flag='0' and del_flag='0'
update lab_reminder set read_flag='1',read_time=#{readTime},update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where recipient_id=#{recipientId} and read_flag='0' and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select g.id goal_id,g.title goal_title,g.year, coalesce(sum(case when t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.plan_date<=date(#{asOf}) then t.goal_weight*milestone.weight/100 else 0 end),0) expected_progress, coalesce(sum(case when t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.workflow_status='CONFIRMED' and t.result_status in ('EXCEEDED','ONTIME','DELAYED') then t.goal_weight*milestone.weight/100 else 0 end),0) actual_progress, coalesce(max(case when blocks.block_start_time is not null then datediff(date(#{asOf}),date(blocks.block_start_time)) else 0 end),0) max_open_block_days, max(case when t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.result_status='DELAYED' then 1 else 0 end) delayed_focus_task, max(case when t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.plan_date<date(#{asOf}) and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') then 1 else 0 end) overdue_unsubmitted_focus_task from lab_goal g left join lab_task t on t.goal_id=g.id and t.del_flag='0' left join lab_goal milestone on milestone.id=t.milestone_id and milestone.parent_id=g.id and milestone.goal_level='QUARTER' and milestone.del_flag='0' left join (select task_id,min(block_start_time) block_start_time from lab_task_block_event where block_status='OPEN' and del_flag='0' group by task_id) blocks on blocks.task_id=t.id where g.goal_level='YEAR' and g.year=#{year} and g.status='ACTIVE' and g.del_flag='0' group by g.id,g.title,g.year order by g.id

select monthly.period, round(sum(monthly.expected_delta) over(order by monthly.period),2) expected_progress, round(sum(monthly.actual_delta) over(order by monthly.period),2) actual_progress from ( select t.period, sum(t.goal_weight*milestone.weight/100) expected_delta, sum(case when t.workflow_status='CONFIRMED' and t.result_status in ('EXCEEDED','ONTIME','DELAYED') then t.goal_weight*milestone.weight/100 else 0 end) actual_delta from lab_task t join lab_goal annual on annual.id=t.goal_id and annual.goal_level='YEAR' and annual.year=#{year} and annual.status='ACTIVE' and annual.del_flag='0' join lab_goal milestone on milestone.id=t.milestone_id and milestone.parent_id=annual.id and milestone.goal_level='QUARTER' and milestone.del_flag='0' where t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.del_flag='0' group by t.period ) monthly order by monthly.period

select (select coalesce(round(100*sum(case when t.workflow_status='CONFIRMED' and t.result_status in ('EXCEEDED','ONTIME','DELAYED') then t.perf_weight else 0 end) /nullif(sum(t.perf_weight),0),2),0) from lab_task t where t.period=#{period} and t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.del_flag='0' ) key_task_completion_rate, (select count(1) from lab_task t where t.period=#{period} and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and t.period_lock_flag='0' and t.del_flag='0' and (t.plan_date<date(#{asOf}) or ) ) overdue_or_pending_count, (select count(1) from lab_task t join lab_task_block_event be on be.task_id=t.id and be.block_status='OPEN' and be.del_flag='0' where t.period=#{period} and t.current_block_flag='1' and t.del_flag='0' and datediff(date(#{asOf}),date(be.block_start_time))>=7 ) blocked_over_seven_count, (select count(1) from lab_asset a join lab_member asset_owner on asset_owner.id=a.primary_owner_id and asset_owner.del_flag='0' where a.status='ACTIVE' and a.del_flag='0' and (a.backup_owner_id is null or not exists(select 1 from lab_member backup where backup.id=a.backup_owner_id and backup.member_status='ACTIVE' and backup.del_flag='0')) and (#{scope.roleKey}='lab_manager' or (#{scope.roleKey}='lab_lead' and asset_owner.biz_line=#{scope.bizLine}) or (#{scope.roleKey}='lab_member' and a.primary_owner_id=#{scope.memberId}))) assets_without_backup_count
select t.workflow_status code,t.workflow_status name,count(1) item_count from lab_task t where t.period=#{period} and t.del_flag='0' group by t.workflow_status order by t.workflow_status

select m.id member_id,u.nick_name member_name,m.biz_line, coalesce(sum(case when t.period=#{period} and t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' then t.perf_weight else 0 end),0) key_task_weight, sum(case when t.period=#{period} and t.workflow_status='ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end) active_task_count, sum(case when t.task_level='week' and t.plan_date between date(#{twoWeekStart}) and date(#{asOf}) then 1 else 0 end) recent_week_task_count, sum(case when t.period=#{period} and t.plan_date<date(#{asOf}) and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') then 1 else 0 end) overdue_count, sum(case when t.period=#{period} and t.current_block_flag='1' then 1 else 0 end) blocked_count, sum(case when t.period=#{period} and t.coordination_required='1' and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') then 1 else 0 end) coordination_count from lab_member m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' left join lab_task t on t.owner_id=m.id and t.del_flag='0' where m.member_status='ACTIVE' and m.del_flag='0' and m.biz_line=#{scope.bizLine} group by m.id,u.nick_name,m.biz_line order by m.biz_line,m.id

select t.id,'TASK' item_type,t.title,t.workflow_status item_status,t.plan_date due_date from lab_task t where t.period=#{period} and t.coordination_required='1' and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and t.del_flag='0' order by t.plan_date,t.id limit 50

select ri.id,'REPORT' item_type,ri.report_no title, concat(ri.lifecycle_status,'/',ri.json_status,'/',ri.markdown_status,'/',ri.word_status,'/',ri.pdf_status) item_status,coalesce(ri.update_time,ri.create_time) due_date from lab_report_instance ri where ri.period=#{period} and ri.del_flag='0' and (#{scope.roleKey}='lab_manager' or (ri.lifecycle_status in ('FINALIZED','SUPERSEDED') and ri.sensitive_flag='0')) order by coalesce(ri.update_time,ri.create_time) desc,ri.id desc limit 20

select ri.id,'REPORT' item_type,ri.report_no title, concat(ri.lifecycle_status,'/',ri.json_status,'/',ri.markdown_status,'/',ri.word_status,'/',ri.pdf_status) item_status,coalesce(ri.update_time,ri.create_time) due_date from lab_report_instance ri where ri.period=#{period} and ri.del_flag='0' and (#{scope.roleKey}='lab_manager' or (ri.lifecycle_status in ('FINALIZED','SUPERSEDED') and ri.sensitive_flag='0')) order by coalesce(ri.update_time,ri.create_time) desc,ri.id desc limit 1

select p.result_status code,p.result_status name,count(1) item_count from lab_perf_score p where p.period=#{period} and p.current_flag='1' and p.del_flag='0' and #{scope.roleKey}='lab_manager' group by p.result_status order by p.result_status

select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.role_key='lab_manager' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' join lab_member m on m.user_id=u.user_id and m.member_status='ACTIVE' and m.del_flag='0' where u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' order by u.user_id
